series_end_reason: From the third quarter of 2025 Moderna's 'COVID' product-sales row carries the footnote 'Includes sales of Spikevax and mNEXSPIKE', so the line is no longer Spikevax alone; the series ends at the last quarter of the earlier definition. The combined COVID rows for 2025Q3 onward are not spliced in.
search_log: Moderna releases and 10-Qs print only total 'Product sales' / 'Net product sales' through 2024Q2 (the COVID-19 vaccine was the only product until mRESVIA approval in May 2024); from 2024Q3 the 10-Q/10-K 'net product sales by product type' table gives COVID and RSV rows
2022Q3 8-K (filed 2022-11-03) is tagged Item 9.01 only, so the 10-Q for the quarter is cited; 2024Q4 derived as FY2024 COVID (10-K) less nine months 2024 COVID-19 (Q3 2024 10-Q)
first_approval_year 2022 is the BLA (Spikevax) approval; the vaccine was authorized for emergency use in December 2020 before approval - verifier may prefer 2020
